scope: Unreleased SDK contract 2.0; no real QQ, deployment, npm publish, git commit or push.

source.algorithm: sha256 of sorted src/**/*.ts relative paths, NUL, contents, NUL

ci.newSource: not pushed; new Windows/Linux matrix and PostgreSQL job not run remotely

benchmark.scope: Five sequential rounds per source on the same Apple M4 / Node 24.21.0; synthetic serial events, fake HTTP and memory persistence. Timing varies; not QQ throughput.

before.workload: Serial synthetic QQ events; native Response bodies without real networking; 64 KiB synthetic image bytes; a 513-value enumeration; default capacities. The pressure case measures correct overload rejection after filling 10000 retained reply scopes. RSS is sampled, not a peak or leak measurement. Compare identical harnesses on the same host.

after.workload: Serial synthetic QQ events; native Response bodies without real networking; 64 KiB synthetic image bytes; a 513-value enumeration; default capacities. The pressure case measures correct overload rejection after filling 10000 retained reply scopes. RSS is sampled, not a peak or leak measurement. Compare identical harnesses on the same host.

postgresTiming.scope: Dedicated TEST_DATABASE_* PostgreSQL, fake QQ HTTP, sequential samples; includes network RTT, not a production capacity claim

soak.scope: Native-clock local sustained run with simulated HTTP and transport, short TTLs and injected errors. Includes guards, slot/rest/option, cooldown, private/group multi-turn prompts, cancellation, timeout, question failure and shutdown. Samples force GC and retain at most 240 points. This is not QQ platform or multi-day production acceptance.

capacity.limits: Synthetic HTTP and handler delays; no QQ or database connection. Virtual time is not wall-clock endurance.

preserved.originalCheckout: existing changes preserved; source refactor is only in attached worktree

unverified: persistent message recovery and cross-process exactly-once are not implemented
